results.title: Early voting begins Thursday
results.description: In-person early voting for the 2026 general election begins Thursday and ends at 3 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 31 in all North Carolina counties.

results.title: 'Book brigade' moves 7,400 books by hand to Hintonburg store's new space
results.description: The Spaniel's Tale, an Ottawa bookstore, moved thousands of books to its new location Saturday with the help of an approximately 80-metre human chain, according to co-owner Cole Davidson.
